// A kd-tree over a copy of its 3D point set: nearest-neighbor and range
// queries. Node 0 is the root; PointIndices is the leaf-order permutation
// of Points. No builder yet: instances come from a host that emits this
// encoding — see
// tracker/decisions/2026-08-04-spatial-structure-construction-in-plato.md.
type KdTree3D
    implements IValue, ISpatialIndex3D, INearestNeighbor3D
{
    Points: Array<Point3D>;
    Nodes: Array<KdTreeNode3D>;
    PointIndices: Array<ItemIndex>;
}
